title: Fuufu Ijou, Koibito Miman
synopsis: Third-year high school student Jirou Yakuin is in love with his childhood friend, Shiori Sakurazaka. The school implements a "marriage practical" or "couples training" program where students are randomly paired to live as pretend married couples and are monitored and rated on their compatibility. Jirou hopes to be paired with Shiori, while the lively Akari Watanabe wants to be paired with her crush, Minami Tenjin. However, Jirou and Akari are paired together, and so are Shiori and Minami. To earn the right to switch partners, the top 10 pairs must achieve a high score, which requires both couples to agree to the switch. Determined to be with their crushes, Jirou and Akari reluctantly agree to act like a married couple to earn enough points, leading to them developing deeper feelings for each other as the story progresses.
